run_googletest_list_tests: run the googletest-list-tests-unittest_ executable with args and return the printed list of tests
test_gtest_list_tests_default: test the default behavior of gtest_list_tests when the flag is not set
test_gtest_list_tests_flag: test using the gtest_list_tests flag set to 0 or 1 to list all tests
test_gtest_list_tests_override: test that gtest_list_tests overrides non-filter flags like gtest_break_on_failure
test_gtest_list_tests_filter: test that gtest_list_tests takes into account the gtest_filter flag for filtering tests
